name: app-shell
title: App Shell
description: The operations page shell: a persistent sidebar, a toolbar, and panes that scroll inside a fixed viewport.
docs: Use for a screen operated by someone, under data-design="operations". Compose AppShell > AppShellSidebar (put a nav inside, laid out flex md:flex-col) + AppShellToolbar + AppShellPanes > AppShellPane (give each an aria-label). From md the viewport is fixed and panes scroll; below md the page scrolls and the sidebar becomes a row. Panes butt against each other on hairlines: no gap, no elevation. A presentation screen uses PageCanvas instead. See DESIGN.md "Profiles".
